en: The Pair of States to be Abandoned by Cultivation, and the Triplet of the Wholesome.

Dependent on a wholesome state not to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state not to be abandoned by cultivation and not unwholesome, by way of root condition. Under root: one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state not to be abandoned by cultivation and not unwholesome, by way of root condition. ... Under root: two; ... pe ... under non-disappearance: two.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a state that is neither to be abandoned by cultivation nor indeterminate, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*)…. Under the root-condition, there are two; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), there are two.
